reviews.title: Five MicroSD cards locked
reviews.text:
Apart from anything else, I am sick of your nagging ads! And after the latest update, I get the feeling you are heading towards disabling some features unless users subscribe.

[edit] I just had to update the number of destroyed MicroSD cards AGAIN! Now FIVE! All genuine Kingston Canvas - I'm even more convinced that this is deliberate vandalism by this app as it didn't happen for years previously.

That said, I have three cameras via CloudEdge and today, I just had to replace a MicroSD card for the fifth time - all of them genuine Kingston Canvas. One card was just fried but three of the cards had become write protected somehow and no way to unlock them using any utility. For some reason, perhaps the aggressive cloud services marketing in the app, it just occurred to me that locking MicroSD cards might be a means of 'encouraging' people to use the cloud services. Call me cynical but it is odd that the same error has occurred on three cards.

Other than that, I wish this app would just do what is necessary and do it quietly. Unfortunately, quite often, when something happens in the field of view of one of my three cameras, they fail to activate. They are all set to be at their highest sensitivity yet on one occasion in the middle of the night, without going into great detail, there were two flashing vehicles and six people coming and going in, out and around my house (all within the field of view of all three cameras) for an hour and not one camera picked anything up.
